youtube.title: Why Post-it Notes Use a Failed Glue 📝 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
In 1968, 3M chemist Spencer Silver was trying to make a super-strong adhesive and accidentally created one made of tiny acrylic microspheres that stuck lightly and peeled off cleanly. Years later, colleague Art Fry used it to keep bookmarks in his hymnbook, which led to the Post-it note. Its weakness is exactly what makes it useful.
